disclaimer: All six providers, names, domains, contacts and API endpoints are invented for this wiki. Country coverage is a mock catalog attribute. No entity is represented as a real partner, licensed provider or clinically authorized service.
provider_definition: A provider is an organization or professional entity responsible for one or more published services. The service defines the conversion contract; the provider performs its work. Objects remain independently addressable after fulfillment.

provider_field_guide.provider_id: Stable pgp_ identifier used by services, requests and provenance.
provider_field_guide.name: Human-readable display name.
provider_field_guide.description: What the provider contributes to the network.
provider_field_guide.supported_stages: One or more of test_planning, wet_lab and bioinformatics.
provider_field_guide.country_codes: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes used here as illustrative service coverage.
provider_field_guide.service_ids: Actual assigned services in this mock catalog; no unregistered transformations are implied.
provider_field_guide.contacts: Illustrative website and operational or integration contacts.
provider_field_guide.api_capability_proposal: How the provider could implement the common request, status, output and callback contract.

shared_api_contract.request_identity: Each execution receives a pgr_ request_id. Provider IDs use pgp_; service IDs use pgs_. Object references use object_id and revision.

service_version.meaning: Pinned service contract version, including its accepted input and output profiles.

form_ref.meaning: Reference to a pgo_form carrying filled fields for the service form_shape. Its fields include requested_at and requested_by.

inputs.meaning: Role-labelled additional pieces required by the service input_slots. Every item has role and object_ref; object_ref contains object_id and revision. An empty array is valid for a form-only service.

shared_api_contract.form_metadata_location: requested_at and requested_by are field entries inside the referenced pgo_form.data.fields. They are not separate service-request payload properties. Server processing timestamps may be returned separately as operational facts.
shared_api_contract.version_binding: Validate form_shape_id and form_shape_version in the referenced form against the pinned service version before acceptance.
shared_api_contract.object_access: References resolve through an authenticated Pocket Genes object access mechanism. The provider receives access only to the pinned input revisions and authorized payloads for that request. Result objects must be registered and accessible before completion is emitted.
shared_api_contract.file_transfer: Large or binary payloads stay in object storage. The API exchanges object references, checksums and media metadata; it does not embed BAM, FASTQ or PDF bytes in request JSON.

idempotency.replay: Return the original request_id and current status for an identical payload.
idempotency.conflict: Return HTTP 409 when a key is reused with a different canonical payload.
idempotency.retention: Provider contract must publish the retention duration; this draft proposes at least 30 days.

authentication.proposal: OAuth 2.0 client credentials for server-to-server calls over HTTPS, with short-lived access tokens and scopes limited to the provider and request operations.
authentication.credentials_in_examples: No credentials, tokens or private keys are included.

status_meanings.received: Request persisted and assigned a request_id.
status_meanings.validating: Provider checks form, object access, compatibility and requested scope.
status_meanings.accepted: Provider has accepted responsibility for the contracted service under the agreed terms.
status_meanings.queued: Accepted work awaits an execution slot.
status_meanings.awaiting_input: An explicit clarification or additional input is required; the response must say what is missing.
status_meanings.completed: Contracted output objects are registered, available and linked through role-labelled outputs.
status_meanings.rejected: Provider declined the request before acceptance, with a reason.
status_meanings.failed: Accepted work could not fulfill its contract, with a reason and recovery information.
status_meanings.cancelled: Request was cancelled under the agreed cancellation terms.

state_rules: Acceptance is explicit; an HTTP 202 response only confirms receipt unless its status field explicitly says accepted.
Normal progression is received, validating, accepted, queued, running, completed. queued can be skipped when work starts immediately.
Validation or active work may enter awaiting_input. The response includes an issues list and the phase to resume after resolution.
rejected is used before acceptance. failed is used after acceptance. cancelled requires the cancellation terms to permit it.
completed, rejected, failed and cancelled are terminal. Rework after a terminal state creates a new request linked to the earlier request.
Physical activity may be irreversible even if later work is cancelled; the service terms define charges and specimen disposition.

issues.message: The declared reference profile does not match this service version.

shared_api_contract.scope_rule: A suitable extension alone does not demonstrate that the requested genes and analysis can be fulfilled. Providers must use explicit scope and analytical-sufficiency evidence associated with the objects and test order. A VCF record list alone does not prove coverage or a negative result.

callback_contract.registration: Pocket Genes callback destination and provider verification public keys are registered during integration configuration. Service requests cannot supply arbitrary callback URLs.
callback_contract.delivery: Provider POSTs events to its preregistered Pocket Genes endpoint over HTTPS.

signature_proposal.signed_message: UTF-8 bytes of PG-Timestamp, a newline, PG-Event-Id, a newline, and the exact raw HTTP body bytes.
signature_proposal.verification: Verify the signature using the registered public key identified by PG-Key-Id, reject timestamps outside a configured tolerance, and deduplicate by event_id.
signature_proposal.key_management: Store private keys outside payloads and rotate registered verification keys with an overlap period. This draft contains no key material.

callback_contract.ordering: Each event includes a monotonically increasing request_revision. Pocket Genes ignores stale revisions and may query GET /service-requests/{request_id} to reconcile current state.
callback_contract.retry: Delivery is at least once. Retry transient non-2xx responses with exponential backoff; retain failed deliveries for reconciliation. Receivers acknowledge already processed event IDs with 2xx.
callback_contract.payload: Include request identity, state, request_revision and role-labelled outputs when completed. Patient details and native file bytes are excluded from callback bodies.

shared_api_contract.role_binding: Each inputs item must name a published input_slots role, satisfy that slot's accepted types and cardinality, and pin its object revision. Each outputs item must name a published output_slots role and contain a compatible object_ref. The separate form_ref always identifies the required pgo_form.
shared_api_contract.object_provenance: Object envelopes retain input_refs for provenance. Service request and result slot bindings use inputs and outputs with explicit roles; these are separate structures.

endpoints.purpose: Retrieve registered output-object references after completion.
Deliver a signed status or completion event to the preregistered endpoint.

variant_analysis_api_example.example_form_note: This complete form example matches the pgfs_variant_annotation version 1.0.0 form_shape, including the required annotation_profile enum. Validate all fields and reject undeclared fields according to allow_unknown_fields=false.

http_error_mapping.400: Malformed JSON or invalid request field structure.
http_error_mapping.403: Client or provider lacks access to the service or referenced objects.
http_error_mapping.404: Requested service or request does not exist within the caller access scope.
http_error_mapping.409: Idempotency conflict, incompatible revision, or results not ready.
http_error_mapping.422: Form or input contract validation failure detected synchronously.
http_error_mapping.500: Provider internal error; reconcile using idempotency before resubmission.

example_walkthrough: Pocket Genes creates or resolves the filled pgo_form, the unannotated VCF and the test_order at exact revisions.
Pocket Genes submits POST /service-requests with form_ref, inputs bound to the variants and test_order roles, the pinned service version and the Idempotency-Key header.
The provider returns a pgr_ request_id, then validates accessible input objects, profile and service compatibility.
The provider accepts and runs only its annotation service. It can be replaced in a future catalog by another provider publishing a compatible contract.
The provider registers the resulting pgo_annotated_vcf with its actual file descriptor, checksum, provenance and scope evidence.
The provider sends the signed completed callback to the preregistered Pocket Genes endpoint.
Pocket Genes verifies and deduplicates the event, retrieves the annotated_variants output object_ref, and makes that object available for another compatible service request.

substitution_rule: A future provider can offer an equivalent transformation by registering its own service with matching input and output contracts, required form shape, scope capabilities and applicable acceptance conditions. Existing services are not silently reassigned. The present catalog contains only the service_ids explicitly assigned to each provider.
